newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 0.28 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 0.28 pct in November.

text.p: Brazil's Indice Geral de Precos - Disponibilidade Interna (IGP-DI) rose 0.28 percent in November, against a 0.22 percent advance in October, the independent research institute Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) said.

The IGP-DI index is a compilation of three indices - the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.24 percent in the period, the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 0.25 percent, and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.58 percent.
The FGV releases the IGP-DI figure once a month.
